description: When closing a pane asks first, and the words it asks in, shared by the Mac and iOS clients (PaneClosePolicy) and the desktop client (soyeht_client::pane_close). A pane that runs a process (a terminal, an agent or a web page) always asks, whether or not anything is running in it. A document and an editor tab ask by rules of their own (writing.json `closing`, and the editor's conflict with the disk), so with nothing to lose they close at once. Closing a workspace is not here: the Mac does not ask for it. Both clients pass every case.
